name: Umezono Kana
source:
Kana is very serious and prideful, with a strong sense of justice. On the volleyball team, she shares a trusting relationship with [url=/c98268]Saaya[/url], but treats [url=/c98251]Mike[/url] harshly. Kana has a tendency to get furious even over tiny things and often falls into misunderstandings. She's childhood friends with [url=/c98279]Maria[/url].

[Translated from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180927080054/http://kimisaki.happyelements.co.jp/charactor/]archived official website[/url]]
